content.short: Coinbase Smart Wallet provides a smart contract account.
content.description: Coinbase Smart Wallet is a Web3 wallet built around a smart contract account. It enables instant wallet creation inside a dApp using just a passkey, with no app downloads, extensions, or seed phrases required. This design lowers barriers to entry for new users by letting them create and access a wallet directly within the application they are using, rather than following traditional setup steps. By removing the need for separate tools, onboarding becomes smoother while preserving on-chain functionality through a single contract-based wallet.
content.meta: Coinbase Smart Wallet enables instant wallet creation in a dapp using a passkey. Discover Coinbase Smart Wallet and other Web3 Wallets on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
